You are purchasing a "2 Lbs. Rocks, Geodes, and Crystals Assorted Lot with Small Hammer" in "Used" condition.
Awesome mixed lot of geodes, crystals, and a handy small hammer – perfect for collectors, rockhounds, or anyone who loves unique natural decor. You’ll receive: - large cut and polished twin-section geode with a smooth blue-grey interior and rough natural exterior - tan geode with a crystal-filled interior and irregular opening - smaller matching geode halves with sparkling grey and white crystal interior - Several additional white crystal clusters and a clear mineral chunk -colorful iridescent purple mineral specimen - small metal hammer, great as a display prop or light rock tool These pieces are great for display, teaching collections, craft projects, or simply adding a bit of natural sparkle to a shelf or desk. The variety of textures, colors, and crystal formations makes this a fun starter set or an interesting addition to any existing collection. Keywords: geode lot, crystal lot, mineral specimens, rockhound collection, agate geode, quartz crystals, tumbled geodes, decor stones, teaching rock set, geology collection
This is a previously owned item being sold AS-IS and have not been tested. Items may have light surface dust/debris and scratches.
Items have varying degrees of wear and residue and may be missing parts.  Expect signs of wear consistent with age.
Condition Notes:
Geode and mineral lot shows typical handling and natural surface wear. The large cut agate-style geode has a polished interior with some minor edge chipping and an unpolished rough exterior. The tan geode with white crystals has an irregular opening and rough outer shell with some small chips. The smaller grey and white crystal geode halves have cleanly broken edges, rough outer surfaces, and intact sparkling crystal interiors. The additional crystal clusters and clear mineral piece are irregularly shaped with rough fractured surfaces. The iridescent purple mineral piece shows uneven coloration and natural texture. The small metal hammer shows finish wear, minor scuffs, and light scratching on the head and handle with some discoloration but no major damage.
